avis.texte: I dont write many reviews but felt inclined to do so for this one. I've been using it everyday cor about three weeks now and I'm honestly in love with this formula. My skin has always struggled with acne and this product has helped clear up my acne so much on my face while providing oil control throughout thr day. I apply it once in the morning and once in the afternoon and thats all I need. It 100% works better than other finishing powders Ive tried. The only con would be that the container it comes in is messy to get powder out of. The formula itself has a light trace smell of sulfur, but it doesnt stick around for very long and it doesnt bother me too much. The tradeoff of having a clear face and superior oil control is worth it in my opinion. Hoping they never stop making this product!
I have sensitive skin and this made my skin itch and burn. Could just be me tho…

This Blemish Repairing Powder has been a life saver! I'm not great at leaving blemishes alone (yes, I pick). And sometimes you have to empty blemishes to make them smaller and be able to cover them. If you've had those issues too, this is a MUST product! After extracting, I use a qtip to dab the powder directly onto the center of the blemish. It soaks up the liquid and dries the spot (sometimes if it produces a lot you may need to wait a few minutes, rinse the area, and repeat applying the powder). Then you can use makeup to smoothly cover the area. It basically forms a seal over the blemish…it stops producing and makeup doesn't soak in. I've also noticed that if I've picked at my skin a lot and apply this powder before bed, my skin isn't a horrible mess in the morning like it used to be. Such a skin saver and I will never be without it again!!!
Doesnt blend well and doest cover red well. I will stick to dr. jart tigergrass and then finishing with laura mercier ulta blur finishing powder.

I use this daily to cover redness. I use a primer, a green cream, then I mix this and a tinted powder to "set" the green cream. It works amazing and my redness gets covered good while still looking very natural. However, I am extremely pale and I almost look ghostly white after using too much of this powder. I recommend getting a tinted powder close to skintone if youre using this to cover redness.

avis.titre: 10/10 Powder for Application Over Active Breakouts
avis.texte: This is an amazing powder to apply over active breakouts when wearing makeup. It has a smooth texture. I've noticed that when I apply it over an active breakout, by the end of the day the breakout is smaller and redness is reduced. I don't apply this on my whole face, I use it to spot conceal and set active breakouts and specific trouble area. Overall a 10/10 product that is essential for anyone who loves to wear makeup but struggles with acne.

This combined with the deep blemish solution and some foundation really helped me to hide a giant zit on my nose during a formal dinner. I also used it ahead of time and the Mario products helped to reduce it for the dinner night.

I am ao suprised!! This powder got rid of my fungal acne in 2 days. i have SUPER oily skin and acne, but yhis powder has helped keep me more matte all day, and has significantly changed my skin. I used to have fungal acne all over my forehead but now its almost entirely gone ans ive inly used this powder twice. This is a must have for oily acne skin. The only thing is it can ebcome solitchy by the end of the day and collect in certsin areas. But if you notice it a quick blott with a paper towel completly fixes it.
It is oil absorbing, but if you have darker skin, you'll need to really blend it into your skin and it is a white/yellowish powder

avis.titre: Must have for breakout prone skin!!
avis.texte: I still get acne even after 40 and have a hard time not popping or picking. I slways dread the morning if I have to go somewhere and try to cover the mess I've made, especially if the wound it still open and trying to heal. This powder has been a game changer… it really sticks and doesn't clog the pores. I only wish they would comemout with darker tints so that the area didnt look so light and yellowish. My fix for that has been to take a powder about 3 shades darker than my skin tone and press it over the yellow powder to darken it enough to blend in. Other than that, it's perfect and I couldn't do without it

This product is the closest dupe to Bare Minerals' Blemish Therapy from back in the day (ifkyk). If you're able to apply it several times a day, your blemish/acne/redness WILL resolve by the next day. It's magical, but quite drying, so remember your moisturizer.

avis.titre: The Only Blemish Treatment You Need!
avis.texte: This has been a staple in my skincare bag for years! A little goes a long way, so this little jar will last months. From attacking a sudden pop-up blemish to preemptive measure for a trouble area monthly…. This is all you need.

This product is a gamechanger for me! I have oily skin that is prone to breakouts. I've been using this product for a month now and my frequency of acne flare-ups have significantly decreased! I did not care for the pad it came with and instead use my own brushes. Post-blemish I use a small brush to target the spot. All other days, I use a foundation brush and put a light layer all over after my setting spray. Keeps me matte and there is no discoloration. 10/10 recommend!

Whom ever was on the team incharge of the new products, thank you. I am so happy with this product! I am a barista. This product is a game changer for my skin! Thank youuuu! I love Mario Badescu's packaging, but for this item i think it would be better if there was a sifter instead of the large holes that disburst the powder.

Love this repairing powder. Thank goodness they invented a new product for acne and oily skin. This DOES NOT show up green on the skin. It has legit ingredients that help with oil control and acne. I used this on a make over and didn't cake up but I did not use thick layer. I think this could be used on mature skin if used the right way. Lightly and with the right skin prep. Convenient for travel and inexpensive. I would use this on a no makeup day for the benefits and it has Zinc Oxide! yay! Extra sun protection on top of makeup!
